summary.text: Upper Extreme Heavenly Eagle is a space path immemorial desolate beast that can enter and leave grotto-heavens it has visited.

claims.text: Fang Yuan finds a dead egg inside the heavenly crystal eagle nest and names it an upper extreme heavenly eagle egg.

Narration states upper extreme heavenly eagles are space path immemorial desolate beasts with rank eight battle strength when mature, and that a mature adult can freely travel the immemorial nine heavens or grotto-heavens. If it has gone somewhere before, it can follow instinct through space and return. Its only named weakness is lifespan: about eighty years, less than an ordinary mortal. When it dies of old age it produces an egg that keeps its memories and accumulated space path dao marks, so the next life grows again from that foundation.
Dense space path dao marks set in a certain pattern on its body give it the innate ability to enter and exit blessed lands and grotto-heavens.
Because the eagle had gone to Hei Fan grotto-heaven before, it is the key to entering that place.

As a newly hatched chick it already stands at a youngster’s height. It has sharp eagle eyes, dark eyes in close view, sparse yellow feathers on the head at first, then a thick feather layer, a strong body, and dark sharp claws that scratch heavenly crystal like thin paper. In a few days it grows as tall as Fang Yuan. A mature upper extreme heavenly eagle is huge, multiple times the size of a whale.

Fang Yuan restores the processed egg with a blood path method tied to Hei tribe bloodline recognition, and a small bird breaks the shell. Hei Fan’s arrangement removed previous-life memories while leaving space path dao mark foundation, and made the chick feel kinship toward the bloodline Fang Yuan presents. Its food is heavenly crystals. At that stage its battle strength is only rank six level, far from maturity, though its flight speed already matches sword escape Immortal Gu in Fang Yuan’s estimate. After hatching, it carries Fang Yuan through space toward that grotto-heaven.
Fang Yuan estimates that the heavenly crystals in Hei Fan grotto-heaven’s storage pool, together with the heavenly crystal eagle nest, should feed it for five to six years.

Fang Yuan forces its growth with time path killer moves, and with heavenly crystals insufficient for the pace, it comes to the verge of starving to death. The immemorial desolate beast dies of hunger, and its trait holds: death yields an egg that will hatch it reborn. Fang Yuan is not sorry to see this life end, since commanding it required him to pose as a person of Hei tribe bloodline, and he means to alter the new egg’s memories with Hei Fan’s true inheritance so the next hatchling obeys him directly.

With the eagle only an egg again, Fang Yuan cannot predict the winner against Ying Wu Xie’s group even with his many Immortal Gu, where had he still had the immemorial desolate beast he would have pursued them immediately.

Fleeing Fang Yuan, Hei Lou Lan warns that the eagle is an immemorial desolate beast that can roam the nine heavens and is likely a life form from the immemorial nine heavens, so it can travel the five regional walls freely, but Ying Wu Xie corrects her: his check of Northern Plains historical records shows Hei Fan’s eagle was raised in Northern Plains, so it would face suppression as well on entering the five regional walls.

Having located a blessed land with a borrowed immortal killer move, Fang Yuan summons the upper extreme heavenly eagle, which carries him through a few circles before piercing through space and bringing him into that new blessed land. Over the following month it displays immense value, letting him get into blessed land after blessed land to explore and annex them.

Facing a stalemate at Ying Wu Xie’s Gu formation, Fang Yuan privately wonders whether Sixth Hair has already learned from Lang Ya land spirit that his upper extreme heavenly eagle is only an egg, which would explain their lack of fear.

Purple Mountain True Monarch offers Fang Yuan the heavenly crystals for nurturing the eagle, then warns him that even turning it into a true immemorial desolate beast might not let him control it, since he knows of Fang Yuan’s enslavement path method. He adds that he has a method of his own for controlling it.
With reverse flow protection seal too risky to use, Fang Yuan turns to the eagle instead: faster, able to move penetrating space, and, as an immemorial desolate beast, extremely tough of body.
When Fang Yuan later seeks to take back what he lost, the upper extreme heavenly eagle is with Ye Fan, and Fang Yuan wants to know why.
